title: merge straight into main

items.content: Software factory: auto plan then execute, auto commit/pull/push, merge queue, Queue tab (one agent owns plan and build)
Auto plan then auto execute on every agent spawned or resumed from a channel
On task done: commit, pull main, push into the merge queue
Merge queue engine that integrates merges one by one
Queue tab next to Info in the channels app
Review the whole factory flow end to end

summary: RUS197 built the software factory, and it's up as PR #56: https://github.com/cypher-asi/aura-harness/pull/56. Agents now plan first, then build, ship and join the merge queue automatically. Merges go straight into main only after the build and tests pass, and the Queue tab sits next to Info. REV69 is reviewing it now. Three gaps are left. A plain `git push` typed by an agent skips the queue. Loca…
